description: Read one reflow2 skill in full, by name (see list_skills) or by the slash command a person types for it ("/gaps", "gaps"). Returns the whole SKILL.md — follow it as written. Call this BEFORE the work the skill covers, not after: these describe how to do the step, not how to report it. Ask for this when you want the full playbook, procedure or step-by-step guide for a kind of task — how to do it properly, not just what exists.

name.description:
The skill's name, as `list_skills` reports it, or the slash command a
person types for it (its `shortcut`), with or without the slash.
